title: Instances when Appropriate Adults were Not Present for Cases Involving Offenders with Mental Disabilities or Young Suspects
what_it_is: Instances when Appropriate Adults were Not Present for Cases Involving Offenders with Mental Disabilities or Young Suspects

sections.label: Appropriate Adults Scheme age threshold
sections.summary: The increased age threshold for the Appropriate Adults Scheme for Young Suspects to include 16- and 17-year-olds is being implemented in phases from 1 April 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As I had announced in Parliament in July 2022, we are in the midst of implementing the increased age threshold for the Appropriate Adults Scheme for Young Suspects (AAYS) to include 16- and 17-year-olds.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This will be done in phases and has started from 1 April 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the past five years, AAs have been successfully activated for all cases where the Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) have requested for these AAs based on the activation criteria.

sections.label: Active volunteers for AA schemes
sections.summary: As of December 2022, there were 359 and 328 active volunteers for the AAYS and the AAs Scheme for Persons with Mental Disabilities respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As of December 2022, there were 359 and 328 active volunteers for the AAYS and AAs Scheme for Persons with Mental Disabilities respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The service providers are the Singapore Children Society (SCS) and the Movement for the Intellectually Disabled of Singapore (MINDS).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They are able to support all AA activation requests today.

sections.label: Extenuating circumstances and same AA
sections.summary: There may be extenuating circumstances requiring something, though it has not happened in the past five years, and the same AA follows the same case where possible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As I also mentioned in my main reply, there may be extenuating circumstances where it is required – though it has not happened in the past five years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the second question, indeed, where it is possible to have the same AA follow the same case, we do so.
